scenarios.scenario-1: Declared commands plan and execute only after trust; argv-only spawning is enforced.
scenarios.scenario-2: Untrusted projects are refused with UNTRUSTED_PROJECT (exit 2); shell-style commands need explicit opt-in.

required-log-markers.marker-1: CLI text output and JSON envelopes are asserted by the tests; no runtime log markers are emitted by library modules.
